test_title: PYST 25: SSC GD Constable - Reasoning (Held on: 2nd November 2021 Shift 3)
subject: reasoning
question:
Which box can NOT be formed if the given sheet of paper is folded to form a box ?

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/24ab1dda801c00c130d7ffa532235a30e39d3738acb9f345e85e200e31549d6b.png]
solution:
The faces opposite to each other are shown below:

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/e91e4dbb4077fcbe2f9e0ad56f5b9fac491d0e4ae630aed24cefbf01a45c5c13.png] 

⇒ As the alternate positions becomes opposite to each other and the remaining two faces becomes opposite to each other.

So, opposite pairs are:

 
• 2 → 9
 
• 3 → 8
 
• 6 → 7

Therefore,

 
• Option(1) → [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/6bb3ff68fe6d1b2523826cc658b4e786b0d19ad02c81676bf6ff461edf87a1c3.png] ⇒As 3, 7 and 9 faces three different sides i.e 8, 6 and 2 respectively, therefore this box can be formed. 
 
• Option(2) → [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/81b99a4225b6322adbf5ddda22b73d7b223b2219779f0a09fdd01ff5e468c394.png] ⇒As 2 and 9 faces each other, so 2 and 9 cannot be on the sides which are not facing each other. Therefore this box cannot be formed.
 
• Option(3) → [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/0b7827a590871dc8ba2c66539c19cbb48c61c08df53a1544f6e87ac76514d485.png] ⇒As 2, 6 and 8 faces three different sides i.e 9, 7 and 3 respectively, therefore this box can be formed. 
 
• Option (4) → [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/9e00bcb59f1baf8cb46b6b2066bbe50eddc0a8dd9621fa5eed5546aefdd5085a.png] ⇒As 9, 7 and 8 faces three different sides i.e 2, 6 and 3 respectively, therefore this box can be formed. 

Hence, "Option - (2)" is the correct answer.
